📱 CleanLoom – Junk Cleaner 
Keep your Android phone running like new with CleanLoom, the cleaner app built for speed, simplicity, and privacy. Easily clean junk files, clear cache, manage apps, organize photos & videos.

🧹 Junk Cleaner
As you use your phone, temporary files and cached data quietly build up. CleanLoom helps you scan, review, and delete unnecessary files safely, freeing up storage for the things that truly matter — apps, photos, and videos.

📱 App Manager
With CleanLoom's App Manager, you can:
View and review all installed apps
Check storage space and data usage per app
Uninstall apps you no longer need

📸 Photo & Video Cleaner
Duplicate screenshots and forgotten videos can clutter your gallery. CleanLoom makes it simple to:
Review photos, videos, and documents
Decide what to keep and what to delete

📂 Large File Finder
Big files take up big space. CleanLoom identifies the largest files on your device so you can:
Spot which items use the most storage
Decide whether to keep or delete them

🔒 Built-In Privacy Protection
All cleaning and file management take place locally on your phone. CleanLoom never uploads, collects, or shares your personal files. Your data stays with you — private, secure, and under your control.
